name: elcreator/adataforseo
description: aDataForSeo — gets your Evolution CMS site found in search: DataForSEO index coverage, technical audit, keyword demand and rank tracking turned into ranked, one-click changes (sSeo fields, redirects, draft pages), run in the background within a budget.

suggest.seiger/sseo: Lets fixes write meta titles, descriptions, robots, canonicals and redirects with one click (without it fixes are shown as instructions)
suggest.seiger/stask: Alternative queue manager: aDataForSeo runs its jobs as an sTask worker when it is installed
suggest.ext-intl: Better diacritics folding for keyword clustering
